bull.probability_evidence: Bull case rests on growth holding near FY2026's 7.3% non-GAAP growth and management's 7%-8% FY2029 target reiterated at the September 2026 Investor Day, while every valuation multiple (P/E, EV/EBITDA, EV/Sales, P/FCF, P/B) sits in the bottom 3-8% of its own 5-year range (fact sheet Valuation table) — a re-rating case contingent on growth proof not yet delivered, tagged [Likely] in the note sec.3 and evaluation bull case.

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.json scenarios.bull.target_price_12m = fact sheet blended bull fair value 203.00 (research/JKHY/2026-10-08-evaluation.md; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Fair value table)

target_band.cite: Half the spread between the bull case's DCF (193.04) and EV/EBITDA (222.90) anchors, relative to the 203.00 blended target: (222.90-193.04)/2 / 203.00 = 0.0736 (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Fair value table)

base.probability_evidence: Base case is the central scenario: the reverse DCF shows the price implies just 0.4% year-1 revenue growth against 7.3% delivered in FY2026 (note sec.3), so the market is modelled to partly, not fully, close that gap to the DCF-only base fair value of 175.62 because the stock's +13% EV/EBITDA and +31% P/E premium to peers FI/FIS/ACIW/QTWO (fact sheet Valuation table) caps further re-rating toward the full 189.78 blend; evaluation tags this [Likely].

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.json scenarios.base.target_price_12m = fact sheet base DCF (not full blend) 175.62 (research/JKHY/2026-10-08-evaluation.md; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Fair value table)

target_band.cite: Half the spread between the base case's DCF (175.62) and EV/EBITDA (218.09) anchors, relative to the 175.62 target: (218.09-175.62)/2 / 175.62 = 0.1209 (factsheet-2026-10-08.md Fair value table)

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case is grounded in the 10-K's disclosed 'price compression between the former and renegotiated contracts' and its warning that fintech point-solutions 'may reduce demand for broader integrated offerings' (10-K, cited in note sec.2 and evaluation bear case, tagged [Likely]), plus the stock already trailing SPY by -22.8pp over 6 months and sitting ~7% below both moving averages with no catalyst evidence yet (evaluation bear case, fact sheet Price table, [Certain]).
